repair_audit.no_edit_reason: Every mechanism anchor and sub-rule called for by all six overlays in this iteration is already present in image-ocr/SKILL.md's receipt overlay and xlsx/SKILL.md's null-contract and delivery-verification notes after rounds 1-3. All six overlays explicitly report editor_direction=preserve or strengthen-already-present-anchors, with multiple overlays stating the gap is 'adherence/operationalization rather than missing mechanism' and that the mechanisms 'exist but are not consistently composed'. The remaining failures (074 amount, 077 amount, 078 amount null-write, 034 date, max_iterations termination) are executor-adherence failures that a fourth iteration of restatement cannot further bind without either (a) duplicating existing bullet text, (b) inserting receipt-specific examples or oracle-adjacent values (prohibited: no receipt-specific answers, filenames, oracle values, verifier assertions), (c) encoding a within-tier post-rounding tiebreaker whose target the overlays themselves disagree about (077 is variously claimed to be 85.54 Shell / 23.25 post-rounding / 23.26 pre-rounding / 10.40 after confusable repair across overlays 1-6), which would smuggle oracle guidance into the skill, (d) reordering or extending the task-declared tier/exclusion lists in violation of the preservation constraint shared across all six overlays, (e) adding an infrastructure parameter (per-image debug budget fraction) that is not skill-controllable and for which no overlay supplies an evidence-supported threshold, or (f) duplicating conditional_multi_pass_ocr_on_noisy_numeric_fields's existing 1x/2x/3x + PSM 6/4 fallback set with a 'mandatory 3x+PSM4' restatement that would narrow the anchor without evidence. Returning no file updates preserves bounded, durable typed localization, scope boundaries, negative boundaries, and reusable mechanism anchors; synthesizes the batch rather than accreting one anecdotal rule per window; and leaves the strengthened round-1 anchors in place to govern adherence in the final iteration.
